title: Golden BOQ take-off dataset — ZIQS SMM + SAZ
description: 20 golden bill-of-quantities measurement cases derived from ZIQS SMM (Zimbabwe Institution of Quantity Surveyors — Standard Method of Measurement) measurement rules and SAZ material/construction standards. Quantities are authoritative take-offs a BOQ generator must reproduce within tolerancePct.

cases.title: Strip footing excavation — 10 m run, 600 mm wide, 600 mm deep
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM earthworks: measured net cubic metres of excavation in the ground; no deduction for trench form in foundation excavation.

expected.description: Excavate strip footings 600 mm wide x 600 mm deep

cases.title: Mass concrete in strip footings — 20 MPa, 10 m x 0.6 m x 0.6 m
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM concrete: measured cubic metres net; SAZ mix design 20 MPa (1:2:4).

expected.description: Mass concrete in strip footings 20 MPa (1:2:4)

cases.title: Blinding concrete 50 mm under strip footings — 10 m x 0.6 m
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: blinding measured cubic metres.

cases.title: Y12 reinforcement in strip footing — 40 m of bar
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: reinforcement measured as mass (tonnes); Y12 unit mass 0.888 kg/m per SAZ rebar schedule.

expected.description: High-yield deformed bars Y12 in strip footings

cases.title: Damp-proof course to 230 mm wall — 10 m run
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: DPC measured in square metres on the wall thickness.

cases.title: Solid external wall 230 mm — 10 m x 2.4 m, deduct 1.8 m2 door
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM masonry: measured square metres, deductions for openings exceeding 1.0 m2.

expected.description: Solid external wall 230 mm thick (common brick)

cases.title: Internal partition wall 115 mm — 4 m x 2.4 m
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM masonry: measured square metres net.

cases.title: Common bricks 400x200x200 mm SAZ 7 MPa — 10 m x 2.4 m x 230 mm boundary
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: bricks counted per thousand; SAZ 7 MPa minimum compressive strength; 293 units for the canonical boundary take-off (matches eval/golden-dataset.ts bricks-10m-boundary).

cases.title: Precast concrete lintels 150 x 75 mm — 2 openings
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: precast concrete lintels counted each.

expected.description: Precast concrete lintels 150 x 75 mm reinforced

cases.title: Solid-core door sets 813 x 2032 mm — 2 nr
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: doors counted each complete with frame and ironmongery.

expected.description: Solid-core flush doors 813 x 2032 x 40 mm complete with frame

cases.title: Floor screed 25 mm — 6 m x 4 m room (24 m2)
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: screeds measured square metres.

cases.title: Wall plaster 1:4 — 20 m perimeter x 2.4 m (48 m2)
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: plaster measured square metres net on walls.

cases.title: Internal emulsion paint (2 coats) — 48 m2 of plastered wall
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: painting measured square metres, 2 coats standard.

expected.description: Interior washable matt emulsion paint 2 coats

cases.title: Ceiling boards 6 mm — 24 m2 room ceiling
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: ceiling measured square metres.

expected.description: Ceiling boards 6 mm on pine grid

cases.title: Skirting 75 mm pine — 20 m perimeter less 2 x 0.9 m doorways
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: skirting measured linear metres, openings deducted.

expected.description: Skirting 75 mm primed pine, mitred corners

cases.title: Ceramic floor tiles 400x400 mm with 5% waste — 24 m2
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: tiling measured square metres; 5% cutting waste per take-off convention.

expected.description: Ceramic floor tiles 400 x 400 mm non-slip incl. 5% waste

cases.title: IBR roof sheeting 0.47 mm — 24 m2 plan at 15 deg pitch
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: roof covering measured square metres on the slope; pitch factor 1.15 for 15 degrees.

cases.title: PVC gutters 110 mm half-round — 2 x 10 m eaves
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: rainwater goods measured linear metres.

cases.title: PVC downpipes 75 mm — 2 x 3 m storey height
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: rainwater goods measured linear metres.

cases.title: WC suite close-coupled + 110 mm waste — 1 nr + 6 m run
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: sanitary fixtures counted each; waste connections measured linear metres.

expected.description: WC suite close-coupled 6 L dual flush

cases.title: Red Pen take-off - trench concrete 12 m3, 420 cement bags required vs 600 quoted
cases.measurementRule: ZIQS SMM: concrete measured cubic metres net; 35 bags cement/m3 -> 420 bags for 12 m3. 600 quoted = 180-bag Ghost Materials variance, leakage at $10/bag = $1,800.
